About

I’m a Computer Science student at the University of Georgia pursuing a New Media Certificate. My interests are centered on networking, systems administration, IT infrastructure, and the hardware and software that keep organizations connected.

Through my roles with UGA Transportation and Clarke County School District, I have gained hands-on experience troubleshooting devices, communication systems, connectivity problems, and end-user technology. I enjoy understanding how systems work, identifying why they fail, and helping restore them reliably.
